title: The volume control via hotkeys doesn’t work in Chromium and Firefox
line: The Media volume up/down shortcuts now change Chrome's and Chromium's volume instead of only moving the on-screen indicator.
explanation: The Media Controller's volume shortcuts set the active player's MPRIS Volume property and showed the OSD as soon as the D-Bus call succeeded. Chrome/Chromium accept that call but ignore it: their Volume always stays 1.0 and nothing is emitted, so the OSD moved (and drifted further with each press) while the sound stayed the same. Now the OSD is shown only once the player reports the new volume; if it doesn't within 500 ms, the player is marked as ignoring MPRIS volume and the kded changes the volume of its PulseAudio/PipeWire streams (matched by the player's process or its children) instead, with the OSD showing that volume. This uses KF6PulseAudioQt, added as an optional dependency of plasma-workspace.

commits.message:
libkmpris: Change the stream volume of players that ignore MPRIS volume

Chromium accepts setting its MPRIS Volume but never applies it, so the
media volume shortcuts only moved the OSD. Wait for the player to report
the change, and otherwise change the volume of its audio streams.

BUG: 526656

media.caption: Master: five presses of Media volume down with Chrome playing; the OSD moves but Chrome's stream in the volume mixer stays at 100%.
Fixed: the same five presses lower Chrome's stream 100% → 75%, and the OSD follows it.
Master after the presses: OSD says 50%, Chrome still at 100%.
Fixed after the presses: OSD and Chrome's stream both at 75%.
